steps.(2a) countable cofinality: an increasing cofinal sequence of indices is extracted (as in AbstractDev.exists_isMaximal_of_sequences); Causal.exists_seq_limit builds the direct limit: ψ n with images in [-n-1, n+1] by Causal.exists_strictMonoOn_extend (right and left extension lemmas), J = ⋃ ψ n '' I n, γ = c n ∘ (ψ n)⁻¹ on each piece (CausalCurveIn.comp; the inverse continuous by continuousOn_of_strictMonoOn_ordConnected); tail-free; the cocone g_i = ψ n ∘ φ_{i, b n} is independent of n by coherence.
steps.(2b) no countable cofinal set: every countable set of indices is bounded; Causal.false_of_rightExcess and Causal.false_of_leftExcess (by t ↦ -t) refute cofinal right and left excesses; then a member k with every later morphism onto exists, and X k is the cocone (φ for j ≤ k, the inverse Equiv.ofBijective for k ≤ j), commuting in all four cases.
steps.(3) maximal is inextensible: Causality.tailFreeMor_inextensible_of_isMaximal, through Causal.exists_tailFree_retraction (T1): a monotone retraction ρ of the extension's interval onto a tail-free sub-interval, c'' ∘ ρ = c'', collapsing two points only inside a constant end piece; ρ ∘ φ is then a morphism (strictly monotone because Z is tail-free), maximality maps back, the new value lies in Z's image: contradiction.

readme_row: | `Causal.CurvesExtendSecondCountable` | — | ETT programme, layer 1 (T-abs-curves-extend-second-countable; no paper label): in a causality on a T1, second countable space, every causal curve of any open `W` over any interval lies on an inextensible causal curve of `W` (`Causality.exists_inextensible_of_t1_secondCountable`), hence `CurvesExtendOn W` for every open `W` and `CurvesExtend` (`curvesExtendOn_of_t1_secondCountable`, `curvesExtend_of_t1_secondCountable`), with no other hypothesis (no T2, no causality, no time function): Zorn on towers (`AbstractDev.exists_isMaximal_of_chainsInherit`) over the tail-free causal curves (`TailFreeCurve`, `tailFreeMor`), a chain of countable cofinality bounded by its direct limit (`exists_seq_limit`), one of uncountable cofinality by a member, since it stops growing at either end (`false_of_rightExcess`, `false_of_leftExcess`, eventual constancy on ω₁), maximal is inextensible by trimming the constant end pieces (`exists_tailFree_retraction`, `tailFreeMor_inextensible_of_isMaximal`); named hypotheses discharged, e.g. `IsCauchySurface.isAcausal_of_t1_secondCountable`; sharpness not formalized (the long ray); 2026-11-21 |

kb entry (pattern) 'Direct limits and trimming of curves over intervals': Causal.exists_seq_limit (a sequence of curves, each a reparametrised sub-arc of the next, has a direct limit curve with compatible ψ n); Causal.exists_strictMonoOn_extend (a strictly monotone map of a sub-interval with bounded ordconnected image extends to the interval, image in [lo - 1, hi + 1]: room for the next step); Causal.continuousOn_of_strictMonoOn_ordConnected (strictly monotone with ordconnected image ⇒ continuous; the ETT-layer twin of the model-layer Causal.Flat.continuousOn_of_strictMonoOn); Causal.exists_tailFree_retraction (T1: trim constant end pieces by a monotone retraction that keeps the values) (T-abs-curves-extend-second-countable).

kb entry (pattern) 'Transfinite recursion inside a proof, and dependent maps φ i j (h : r i j)': get an opaque sequence with only its equation, obtain ⟨seq, hseq⟩ : ∃ seq : Ordinal.{0} → ι, ∀ α, seq α = F (range fun β : Iio α => seq β.1) := ⟨_, fun α => Ordinal.lt_wf.fix_eq (C := fun _ => ι) _ α⟩; ω₁ is a limit by Cardinal.isSuccLimit_omega 1 (then IsSuccLimit.succ_lt). Do not rewrite seq (succ α) = nx j under φ's dependent type: state the lemma for an arbitrary k with the hypothesis k = nx j and rintro ⟨j, hij, rfl⟩; store transports as ∃ T, ∀ β α h, T β α = φ _ _ h (a dite), so later statements carry no proof terms (T-abs-curves-extend-second-countable).
